intro: Village Roll Call uses native rewards on Twitch and Kick, plus Viewer Foundation points and a command on YouTube and TikTok.

sections.title: 1. Connect each platform
sections.description: Paste the Twitch and Kick reward IDs. Create the no-response check-in command for YouTube and TikTok, which spend Viewer Foundation points.
sections.notice: Recommended Twitch/Kick reward — title: Village Roll Call; cost: 50; color: #2E8B57; description: 'Check in once today and build your monthly village attendance.' Viewer input off. Enable Skip Reward Queue for Twitch because this add-on records the check-in directly. Streamer.bot documents no Kick refund method, so a duplicate Kick claim cannot be returned automatically.

sections.title: 2. Check-in messages
sections.description: Successful check-ins show the viewer's monthly count and rank. Repeat redemptions never increase the score.

sections.title: 3. Monthly winner
sections.description: The previous month is archived and announced on the first stream-online or valid check-in event in the new month.

sections.title: 4. Optional OBS card
sections.description: The hosted browser source briefly shows a bounded leaderboard after each successful check-in. Use Send preview card before going live.

sections.title: Privacy and storage
sections.description: Stores platform-qualified stable user IDs, current display names, daily/monthly counters, and a bounded replay list in private atomic state.
sections.notice: The existing Twitch and Kick intake actions provide rewards. YouTube and TikTok commands are generated by Command Sync. Simulated events preview the card but never change scores or points.
